scope: Targeted broad search and direct author-source reading, not a systematic survey.
technical_claim_policy: Primary papers/author code/blog for technical facts. Firsthand community leads separately marked; no reproduced currentWan result from external sources.

entries.name: SVDtrunc paper
entries.review_depth: Read sections3.1–3.3,4.3–4.6 including four-step FLUX.schnell, metric denominator and training objective.
entries.mechanism: Projection factorization retains nonlinear widths; task-level block ranking, modular KD and flow matching.
entries.Wan_HiF4_transfer_limit: Paper budgets backbone parameters, not current FFN mainMAC; four-step image model is not dual-expert quantized Wan video. Reported aggregate quality does not imply each axis meets2%.
entries.research_consequence: Compare a full-H factorized operator against affine-remainder representation; require native numerics and real full-chain cost first.

entries.name: SVDtrunc author project
entries.review_depth: Read method, training-free versus fine-tuned results and domain/memorization drift discussion.
entries.mechanism: Explains projection-level redundancy and distinct perceptual versus paired-error criteria.
entries.Wan_HiF4_transfer_limit: Project explanation is not independent evidence from the paper. Smooth degradation is not acceptance.
entries.research_consequence: Do not duplicate paper/project as two independent experiments.

entries.name: SVD-LLM
entries.review_depth: Read3.1 whitening derivation,3.2 sequential update motivation.
entries.mechanism: Covariance-weighted low-rank approximation and adaptation to upstream compressed inputs.
entries.Wan_HiF4_transfer_limit: Whitening matches empirical linear reconstruction only; R8F2 shows danger of empirical-nullspace freedom. Native GELU/HiF4 casts break any assumed exact functional equivalence.
entries.research_consequence: Any data-aware factorization needs source-level validation and weight-error reporting, not just truncation energy.

entries.name: SVD-LLM author code
entries.review_depth: README workflow and dependency requirements only; implementation not ported.
entries.mechanism: Separates whitening, sequential recovery and quantization.
entries.Wan_HiF4_transfer_limit: LLM architecture/version assumptions differ. No environment upgrade or direct import authorized by relevance alone.
entries.research_consequence: Use as implementation reference only.

entries.name: SlimDiff
entries.review_depth: Read2.2–2.5, especially Type-I FFN Nyström and timestep covariance.
entries.mechanism: Select intermediate columns using correlation geometry and refit down projection; functional-group coupling.
entries.Wan_HiF4_transfer_limit: FFN selected-feature least squares overlaps WR1/JR1, not a new action family. A new CPQR order alone cannot reopen rejection. Attention/gated-FFN experiments differ.
entries.research_consequence: Keep as nearest baseline for subset reconstruction, not new main route.

entries.name: DyDiT
entries.review_depth: Read3.2–3.4, token gather/scatter, training loss and experiment setup.
entries.mechanism: Train timestep widths jointly with spatial MLP bypass; actual inference slices/gathers.
entries.Wan_HiF4_transfer_limit: Requires end-to-end recovery, token routing and all costs; most results use many sampling steps. Current token-level HiF4 grouping/stride needs equivalence proof.
entries.research_consequence: Spatial information and learned actions are a distinct option from per-row C-head fitting, but current random rows are not neighborhood training data.

entries.name: DyDiT author implementation
entries.review_depth: README plus lineage to original inference-only repository; not a code reproduction.
entries.mechanism: Published training/inference routes for dynamic width/token decisions.
entries.Wan_HiF4_transfer_limit: Cannot copy paper FLOPs or speed; not current native Wan.
entries.research_consequence: Potential reference if selecting a recovery-training project; no router job registered.

entries.name: Dense2MoE
entries.review_depth: Read3.1–3.2 and4.1, including activated-parameter denominator, groupedGEMM timing and32A100 training.
entries.mechanism: Shared expert plus conditional experts and multi-stage output/feature distillation.
entries.Wan_HiF4_transfer_limit: RB2 finite C-banks were weak, while this method changes weights/objective/actions. Full conversion training budget and grouped dispatch cannot be inferred feasible on2 GPUs.
entries.research_consequence: Defer full conversion; borrow matched training and capacity-preserving representation, not add more banks to RB2.

entries.name: Elastic DiT
entries.review_depth: Read3.2–3.3 including router, STE, explicit slicing and performance/efficiency objective.
entries.mechanism: Jointly trained content-dependent block and width allocation.
entries.Wan_HiF4_transfer_limit: A soft average FLOPs penalty is not our exact fixed50% deployed budget; cache cold start remains.
entries.research_consequence: Useful global recovery/allocation comparator; not evidence for changing only the old UB2 step budget.

entries.name: MosaicDiff
entries.review_depth: Read3.2–3.4: stage division, SNR-aware calibration and structural OBS. CVF PDF403; used full arXivHTML.
entries.mechanism: Stage-specific covariance and structural second-order weight updates.
entries.Wan_HiF4_transfer_limit: DDPM/SNR assumptions do not directly match four-step distilled scheduler. Proxy quadratic and covariance transfer remain local.
entries.research_consequence: No post-validation damping/budget sweep; any allocation study needs current downstream utility under one fixed total budget.

entries.name: GPTQv2/GPTAQ asymmetric calibration
entries.review_depth: Read3–4.1 objectives and residual correction; v1 titleGPTQv2 retained.
entries.mechanism: Student inputs are matched to original-model outputs instead of same-student-input teacher outputs.
entries.Wan_HiF4_transfer_limit: OP2/OP3 same-input teacher only tests function error. New own-trajectory paired teacher output requires alignment and cannot be fabricated from unrelated cached rows.
entries.research_consequence: Separate same-state repair and trajectory repair in future objectives; no universal superiority claim.

entries.name: HQQ author blog
entries.review_depth: Read calibration-bias discussion, robust weight objective and quantizer formulation. Oldmobius URL redirected/moved.
entries.mechanism: Calibration-free robust weight-error optimization provides a contrasting source-independent objective.
entries.Wan_HiF4_transfer_limit: Uniform/groupwise codebook differs from original native HiF4; does not preserve an unchanged quantizer. Weight-error robustness is not pruned-neuron recovery.
entries.research_consequence: Motivates reporting extrapolation/weight norm; no replacing frozen quantizer or calling HQQ a direct fix.

entries.name: HQQ official implementation
entries.review_depth: README mechanism, backend/axis quality-speed restrictions, no code port.
entries.mechanism: Shows precision/axis and real backend constraints.
entries.Wan_HiF4_transfer_limit: No current HiF4 numeric compatibility established.
entries.research_consequence: Keep operator/precision declaration explicit.

entries.name: ComfyUI GPTQ calibration author implementation
entries.review_depth: Read README full/block/DLR/Nyström and expert sigma-range controls; openedcalibration.py but did not audit2626lines.
entries.mechanism: Practical collection of covariance and maxima with storage/CPU-memory tradeoffs.
entries.Wan_HiF4_transfer_limit: Author marks code insufficiently tested; approximate Hessian formats are not proof of fidelity. Community sigma boundary is not current scheduler contract.
entries.research_consequence: A collection-engineering lead only. Existing private native/source controls govern any reuse.

entries.name: TARDIS
entries.review_depth: Read affine folding mechanism and7.7 finite precision; fuller review than R7abstract.
entries.mechanism: Per-neuron linear ranges folded into a constant matrix with nonlinear corrections.
entries.Wan_HiF4_transfer_limit: LLM predictor/hot-range assumptions and permissive quality differ; BF16 reordering can itself matter.
entries.research_consequence: Known transfer supports originalR2 learned affine design, not novelty. R8extra quantization failure cannot close originalBF16 operator.

entries.name: PPCL
entries.review_depth: Re-read3.1–3.3, teacher-input interval distillation and linear replacement algorithm.
entries.mechanism: Contiguous functional units and recovery-based substitution.
entries.Wan_HiF4_transfer_limit: R7D1 pair has little additive gain interaction; no evidence every Wan interval is redundant. Teacher-input interval training still differs from rollout.
entries.research_consequence: Borrow window-level loss, not arbitrary layer removal.

entries.name: Dynamic-in-Few-Step
entries.review_depth: Read4.1–4.2, progressive reverse-order structural training and output rollout.
entries.mechanism: Joint structural optimization with final-output distribution and staged curriculum.
entries.Wan_HiF4_transfer_limit: DMD/fake-score/model adaptation have real training/memory requirements. Two-gain secants are not a reproduction.
entries.research_consequence: Use to motivate native rollout recovery plus cost audit, not restart closed gainfit with different bounds.

entries.name: TinyFusion
entries.review_depth: README recoverability objective; paper abstract verified.
entries.mechanism: Low calibration error need not imply recoverable pruned network; learns recoverability.
entries.Wan_HiF4_transfer_limit: Depth pruning/fine-tuning setup differs from frozen FFN compression. No implementation reproduced.
entries.research_consequence: Do not equate local fit, post-recovery quality and final deployed quality.

entries.name: Self Forcing
entries.review_depth: Project mechanism and author abstract; full training code not audited.
entries.mechanism: Training on self-generated histories and holistic sequence supervision.
entries.Wan_HiF4_transfer_limit: Autoregressive frame histories differ from four-step bidirectional denoising. No change to causal architecture proposed.
entries.research_consequence: Conceptual support for deployment-state training only; not a drop-in algorithm.

entries.name: SVDQuant/Nunchaku
entries.review_depth: Read full mechanism and branch-fusion explanation again.
entries.mechanism: High-precision low-rank outlier branch shares activation loads with quantized path through fusion.
entries.Wan_HiF4_transfer_limit: Quantization-error low rank differs from omitted nonlinear-neuron error; hardware formats/baselines differ.
entries.research_consequence: Any auxiliary correction must pay actual activation traffic and launch cost.

entries.name: LightWan2.2 author blog
entries.review_depth: Read phasedDMD/truncation and quantization/operator co-design.
entries.mechanism: Changes training, model and execution together.
entries.Wan_HiF4_transfer_limit: NVFP4/Blackwell/sparseattention release is not same pinned HiF4/A100 checkpoint.
entries.research_consequence: Borrow staged supervision and nativeforward awareness; do not substitute a released fastermodel as our sparse candidate.

entries.name: Neuron Merging
entries.review_depth: Abstract/author conditions only.
entries.mechanism: Scaling matrix can fold into next layer under restricted ReLU conditions.
entries.Wan_HiF4_transfer_limit: GELU and HiF4 are not positively homogeneous ReLU; W2readout merging overlaps oldWR1/JR1.
entries.research_consequence: No equivalence claim or new job based on cosine-neuron similarity alone.

entries.name: Wan timestep-aware SVDQuant-GPTQ
entries.review_depth: ReadIII methodology and original baseline/quality definition; author repository landing page also checked.
entries.mechanism: Combines low-rank outlier path, residualGPTQ and expert/timestep clipping.
entries.Wan_HiF4_transfer_limit: Changes densequant baseline, not50%FFNmainMAC. Abstractimaging drop2.3%is already larger than our2%axis limit, on another model/protocol.
entries.research_consequence: Useful nativeWan calibration baseline; not evidence our strict candidate requirements are solved.

entries.name: Wan HiF4 SmoothQuant/MixQ submission
entries.review_depth: ReadIII-A–F and linked repository layout.
entries.mechanism: Static outlier-column highprecision branch plus smoothing/blockpacking.
entries.Wan_HiF4_transfer_limit: Additional highprecision operations, challengeexceptions and geometry differ. Current frozenQDQ cannot silently change.
entries.research_consequence: If new mixedprecision representation is chosen, specify everycast/branch and benchmark all costs.

entries.name: Wan quantization community discussion
entries.review_depth: Read post and corrections on one-file versus twoexpert execution.
entries.mechanism: Community packaging claims can misstate the actual model computation.
entries.Wan_HiF4_transfer_limit: Anecdote/discussion only; technical mechanism checked against authorpaper. No independent accuracy evidence.
entries.research_consequence: One checkpointfile does not remove oneexpert or halve denoising. No community speed inherited.
